agent.notes: The PR adds a curl_cffi direct-HTTP path (_ensure_token and _search_via_api, which call booking.flyscoot.com) to the Scoot scraper and renames the existing CDP-Chrome path to _search_via_browser as a fallback. Every changed line is network or browser I/O against the live Scoot site; the response parsing is unchanged. With the I/O replaced by stand-ins there would be nothing meaningful left to measure, and the base path needs real Chrome and the live website.
